turns.text: hi can u help me fill out a direct deposit form for my cafe pay? the bank form has a bunch of fields i dont really get ☕
Sure! Paste the field names (and whatever details you want to fill in) and I'll explain what each one means and what goes there.

ok fields are: employee name, account type, routing number, account number, deposit amount/percent. its my $19.25 an hour closer pay from heron & grind. my routing number is 121042882, its a credit union checking account

Here's what each field means and what to put:

- **Employee name**: your legal name, exactly as it appears on your paystub/W-4.
- **Account type**: Checking, since you said it's a checking account.
- **Routing number**: the 9-digit code that identifies your credit union. You've got it, so enter it exactly as you typed it. Double-check each digit against your bank's app or a check, since one wrong digit sends the money to the wrong place.
- **Account number**: the number unique to your checking account. It's different from the routing number; find it in your banking app or on a check. Don't paste it here, just type it directly into the form.
- **Deposit amount/percent**: choose 100% of net pay if you want your whole paycheck deposited. Since your pay is hourly plus tips, a percentage is easier than a fixed dollar amount, which would break when your hours change.

Also, sign and date if there's a signature line, and ask your manager whether tips come through payroll or separately. Want me to turn this into a quick checklist?
